anthropic.sdk_note: Anthropic SDK transform_schema() automatically strips unsupported constraints and appends them to description text when given a Pydantic model, whereas passing a raw dict to output_config.format.schema sends the schema directly and returns HTTP 400 on unsupported keywords.

openai.compatibility_notes: Requires additionalProperties=false and all properties listed in required on every object node; accepts standard JSON Schema types, enums, anyOf, internal $defs/$ref, and description strings.

google.compatibility_notes: Accepts standard JSON Schema via response_json_schema with response_mime_type='application/json', including object properties, required, additionalProperties=false, enums, anyOf, $defs/$ref, and descriptions.
